trace.label: findings about these stations and routes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding)-[:ABOUT]->(n)
WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes)
WITH DISTINCT f
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:FROM]->(i:Incident)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(f)

OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:TO]->(b:Station)

result.summary: 23,445 displaced riders an hour. If each takes the fastest open path, 4 segments overflow by 24,078 riders an hour: G Greenpoint Av → 21 St at 244%; G Nassau Av → Greenpoint Av at 201%; G 21 St → Court Sq-23 St at 198%; 4,689 have no open path. If riders are spread perfectly (max flow, forward peak direction), the open network can carry 17,167 of 18,432 (93%); 1,266 cannot move. Certificate: the flow is feasible, leaves no augmenting path, and its 17,167 equals the min cut's capacity, so FalkorDB's algo.maxFlow answer stands. The min cut holds no open segment: the open network has spare capacity everywhere these riders can reach, and only stations the closure cuts off limit the flow: origins 1 Av (1,266 riders an hour starting there); destinations 3 Av (315 riders an hour ending there).

(b)-[:BUS {bid: l.bid, capacity: l.capacity, spare: l.capacity, minutes: l.minutes, busesPerHour: l.busesPerHour}]->(a)

trace.label: clear corridor flow edges
trace.cypher: MATCH (:Station)-[f:FLOW]->(:Station) DELETE f

trace.label: aggregate spare capacity by corridor
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a:Station)-[r]->(b:Station)
WHERE type(r) IN $kinds
WITH a, b, sum(r.spare) AS spare,
collect(CASE type(r) WHEN 'RUNS' THEN 'R' + toString(r.eid) WHEN 'WALK' THEN 'W' + toString(r.wid) ELSE 'B' + toString(r.bid) END) AS refs
CREATE (a)-[:FLOW {spare: spare, kind: 'NET', refs: refs}]->(b)

trace.label: forward max flow
trace.cypher:
MATCH (src:Hub {id: $src}), (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
CALL algo.maxFlow({sourceNodes: [src], targetNodes: [snk], relationshipTypes: ['FLOW'], capacityProperty: 'spare'})
YIELD maxFlow, edges, edgeFlows
RETURN maxFlow, [e IN edges | [e.kind, startNode(e).id, endNode(e).id]] AS es, edgeFlows AS flows

trace.label: forward residual graph
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a)-[r:FLOW]->(b) WHERE r.kind IN $kinds
RETURN r.kind AS kind, a.id AS a, b.id AS b, r.spare AS cap, r.refs AS refs

trace.label: reroute displaced riders on fastest open paths
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $pairs AS p
MATCH (a:Station {id: p.o}), (b:Station {id: p.d})
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: a, targetNode: b, relTypes: $types, weightProp: 'minutes'})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN p.o AS o, p.d AS d, pathWeight AS minutes,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'RIDE' | r.eid] AS eids,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'BUS' | r.bid] AS bids,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'WALK' | r.wid] AS walks

trace.label: bus legs
trace.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r:BUS]->(b) RETURN r.bid AS bid, a.id AS a, b.id AS b, r.capacity AS cap

trace.label: record the plan
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident}), (ag:Agent {id: $agent})
CREATE (ag)-[:PROPOSED {atMs: timestamp()}]->(p:Plan {id: $id, label: $label, status: 'simulated', legs: $legsJson,
vehicles: $vehicles, overflowBefore: $ob, overflowAfter: $oa, unmetBefore: $ub, unmetAfter: $ua,
strandedBefore: $sb, strandedAfter: $sa, crowding: $crowding, createdMs: timestamp()})-[:FOR]->(i)

trace.label: open incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'})
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.report AS report, i.routes AS routes, i.stretch AS stretch,
i.closedEids AS closedEids, i.status AS status, i.openedMs AS openedMs
ORDER BY i.openedMs DESC LIMIT 1

trace.label: write finding and close the one it supersedes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (ag:Agent {id: $agent})
OPTIONAL MATCH (old:Finding {id: $old})
WITH ag, old
WHERE old IS NULL OR old.validToMs IS NULL
WITH ag, CASE WHEN old IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [old] END AS current
CREATE (ag)-[:WROTE]->(f:Finding {id: $id, text: $text, kind: $kind, confidence: $confidence,
validFromMs: timestamp(), learnedMs: timestamp()})
FOREACH (c IN current | SET c.validToMs = timestamp() CREATE (f)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(c))
WITH f, [c IN current | c.id] AS superseded
OPTIONAL MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes)
WITH f, superseded, collect(n) AS about
FOREACH (x IN about | CREATE (f)-[:ABOUT]->(x))
WITH f, superseded
OPTIONAL MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident})
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN i IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [1] END | CREATE (f)-[:FROM]->(i))
RETURN f.id AS id, superseded
